Jio Financial Services Ltd – Q2 & H1FY27 | Concall Insights

Financial Performance & Earnings Growth
•Q2 consolidated income, excluding dividend impact, grew 132% YoY to ₹1,699 Cr, while PPOP increased 85% to ₹574 Cr.
•Q2 reported PAT stood at ₹340 Cr, versus ₹695 Cr YoY, impacted by dividend timing and investments in newer businesses.
•Core operating businesses gaining scale, although consolidation changes also contributed to reported income growth.

Jio Credit – Primary Earnings Growth Engine
•Loan AUM surged 154% YoY to ₹37,320 Cr, with Q2 disbursements increasing 98% to ₹13,135 Cr.
•Net interest income grew 116% YoY to ₹302 Cr, while PAT increased 140% to ₹120 Cr.
•Secured mortgages account for 44.5% of AUM, with corporate/SME loans contributing 44.2%.
•Bank of America to acquire 49.9% stake, bringing approximately ₹18,000 Cr growth capital, subject to regulatory approvals.
•Initial capital infusion of ~₹9,500 Cr expected to strengthen lending capacity.

JioBlackRock – Investment Business Expansion
•AMC AUM reached ₹22,746 Cr, growing 57% YoY and 24% QoQ.
•Distribution expanded to 15,000+ mutual fund/SIF distributors, accelerating customer acquisition.
•Launched self-directed broking and expanding wealth management offerings, creating future fee-income opportunities.
•Asset management and broking remain in their investment phase, with profitability dependent on achieving scale.

Payments – Higher-Margin Growth
•Jio Payments Bank deposits increased 53% YoY to ₹643 Cr, supported by 40 lakh CASA customers.
•Payments Bank quarterly income grew 213% YoY to ₹94 Cr.
•Payment Solutions processing margin expanded to 14 bps from 9 bps YoY, following exit from low-margin merchants.
•Net payment fee income grew 74% YoY to ₹21 Cr, demonstrating improving transaction economics.

Insurance – New Growth Opportunity
•Insurance broking fee income increased 46% YoY to ₹54 Cr, with premiums facilitated reaching ₹346 Cr.
•Allianz reinsurance JV generated ₹510 Cr gross written premiums in its first six months.
•General and health insurance JV awaiting regulatory approval; life insurance partnership remains under discussion.
•New insurance businesses offer longer-term earnings diversification but will require initial investment.

Digital Ecosystem & Operating Leverage
•JioFinance digital platforms reached 3.2 Cr unique users, with approximately 80 lakh monthly active users.
•AI-driven personalization delivered 59% improvement in customer conversion.
•Around 36,000 financial products purchased daily across digital platforms, strengthening cross-selling potential.
•Integrated lending, investments, payments and insurance ecosystem expected to reduce customer acquisition costs and improve operating leverage.

Balance Sheet & Key Risks
•Consolidated net worth stood at ~₹1.3 lakh Cr, providing substantial growth capital.
•Jio Credit borrowing cost remained stable at 7.08%, despite rapid expansion.
•Key monitorables include lending asset quality, funding costs, regulatory approvals, profitability of new ventures and returns on deployed capital.

Key Takeaway
•Future earnings growth visibility driven by 154% lending AUM growth, ₹18,000 Cr proposed Bank of America investment, rapid JioBlackRock scaling, improving payments margins and insurance business expansion.
•Key monitorables: Jio Credit NII/PAT growth, capital infusion approval, AMC profitability, insurance commercialization and conversion of ecosystem scale into sustainable consolidated earnings.

result.text:
None of the new AI-agent contracts from Citigroup ($C), JPMorgan Chase ($JPM), Bank of America ($BAC), PNC ($PNC), Wells Fargo ($WFC), Citizens Financial ($CFG) or Ally ($ALLY) describe a scoped token with a spend limit and an expiry date that can move money. The closest they will sell you is a read-only connection for a statement.

JPMorgan Chase lets outside tools, AI included, pull account data through approved APIs with your authorization, so the app never sees your password.

PNC lets you link an agent by signing in at PNC itself and picking which accounts, which data, and for how long. Starting Dec. 19, PNC also bars an outside AI agent from making a payment or transfer unless the bank says otherwise.

The federal rule that would have forced those safer connections is frozen. The CFPB's open-banking rule, finished in November 2024, requires banks to share your data with apps you approve through secure links.

A federal judge in Kentucky put it on hold on Oct. 29, 2025, and the bureau's rewrite still has not been published. Even if it were live, it covers reading your data, not moving your money.

So a leak of an approved data connection might expose a statement. A spend-limited token that can send a payment is not what these banks are offering.

Chase's approved-API language, PNC's pick-the-accounts-and-the-duration link, and the 2024 open-banking rule a Kentucky judge froze, which still would not have covered a payment, are all in the full piece, next to the seven contracts:
https://t.co/DyniHhnWoL

Context matters:
• The whole market sold off Thursday, with the largest S&P 500 fund down ~2%, so a little over half of the move was macro.
• Mizuho's desk said many hedge funds were positioned for a "sell-the-news" event.
• Bank of America analysts set the bar at ~$1.9B in the first 3 days. Sensor Tower's latest outside estimate is already ~$2.36B through launch day (not an official figure).
• Take-Two hasn't published a sales number yet. In 2013 it announced GTA V's $800M+ day one the very next day.

History rhyme: $TTWO also slipped 2.0% on GTA V launch day in 2013, and was up 32.5% a year later. One data point, not a rule.

X chatter about Take-Two stock went from under ~100 posts a day (Nov 13-15) to 671 on Nov 19 (X API, no reposts).
